requirements.statement: A Customer can view the current status of their order

criteria.must: A signed-in customer can open an order and see its current status
The displayed status reflects the most recent status change

requirements.statement: A Customer can view the full status history of their order

criteria.must: A signed-in customer can view a chronological list of every status change for their order

requirements.statement: A Customer receives an email notification whenever their order's status changes

criteria.must: An email notification is sent to the customer each time their order's status changes
The email content clearly states the new status and identifies the order

requirements.statement: A Customer signs in and can only see their own orders

criteria.must: An unauthenticated user cannot view any order data
A signed-in customer cannot view or list another customer's orders

requirements.statement: A Staff member can manually create a new order

criteria.must: A signed-in staff member can create a new order by entering its details
A newly created order starts in the Placed status

requirements.statement: The external storefront website can create an order automatically via an inbound API call

criteria.must: A valid authenticated API call from the storefront creates a new order in the Placed status
An API call without valid credentials is rejected

requirements.statement: A Staff member can update an order's status through its lifecycle

criteria.must: A signed-in staff member can change an order's status to Processing, Shipped, Out for Delivery, or Delivered
Each status change is recorded in the order's status history

requirements.statement: A Staff member can cancel an order

criteria.must: A signed-in staff member can cancel an order that is not yet Delivered
A cancelled order is shown as Cancelled to the customer

requirements.statement: A Staff member can view a dashboard listing all orders and their current statuses

criteria.must: A signed-in staff member can view a list of all orders in the system with each order's current status

requirements.statement: A Staff member can assign an order to a delivery courier

criteria.must: A signed-in staff member can assign an order to a specific delivery courier

requirements.statement: A Delivery Courier can view the list of orders assigned to them

criteria.must: A signed-in delivery courier sees only the orders assigned to them

requirements.statement: A Delivery Courier can update an order's status to Out for Delivery and Delivered

criteria.must: A signed-in delivery courier can change an assigned order's status to Out for Delivery
A signed-in delivery courier can change an assigned order's status to Delivered
A delivery courier cannot change the status of an order not assigned to them
